system.name: Response Length Perception and Sequence Scheduling
system.one_liner: LLM inference pipeline that predicts each response length, groups requests of similar length into micro-batches and recomputes failures, raising throughput.

content.variant_note: left panel diagnoses naive batching on six toy requests, right panel redraws the same six through perception, scheduling and failure recomputation
content.argues: Mixing short and long responses in one batch makes 66% of generated tokens redundant; predicting length, regrouping requests and recomputing failures avoids this waste.
content.subject: Six numbered requests with response-length bars, batched naively on the left and scheduled by predicted length on the right.

new_tags.name: padding-bars
new_tags.what: wasted or padded computation drawn as a white bar with a grey edge that continues a short bar up to the batch maximum

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a batching or scheduling fix by redrawing the same numbered items as length bars before and after, with waste drawn as a white continuation up to the batch maximum and one boxed percentage as the cost.
lessons.suits: Systems or efficiency methods about batching, padding, scheduling or load balance, where a toy set of numbered items can stand in for real workloads.

evidence: Vanilla batch inference leads to underperformance with 66% redundant tokens
Failure collection and recomputation strategy is adopted to avoid wrong predictions degenerating the performance.

summary: The paper speeds up LLM inference by letting the model perceive each response length, grouping requests of similar predicted length into micro-batches and recomputing failures. Figure 1 follows six numbered toy requests. On the left, vanilla batching pads short responses to the longest in the batch, drawn as white tails, and a boxed 66% counts the waste. On the right, the same requests pass a Response Length Perception box that adds dashed predicted-length bars, a Sequence Scheduling box that regroups them into variable micro-batches, and a failure collection and recomputation path in red. Flat pastel bars, orange dashed batch frames, sans text.
summary_zh: 论文用大模型预测每条回复的长度，再把长度相近的请求编入同一微批，失败的再重算。图1用六条编号请求对比：左边朴素分批产生66%冗余计算，右边经感知、调度和失败重算三步。
notes: Prior variant paired-lanes changed to problem-then-fix because the left panel is a failure diagnosis with a 66% callout. The 9 small bitmaps in the SVG are the shaded redundant-computation bars, not data pictures, so pictures is empty. What 15% measures is not stated in the caption.
